prompts.title: Gritty Mechanic Editorial Portrait AI Prompt
prompts.prompt: Generate an image of the person from the attached photo. Preserve exact facial likeness. The image should be a gritty and dramatic fashion editorial-style portrait, set in a dimly lit auto repair garage. The composition is a low-angle medium shot, making the subject appear powerful and statuesque. The subject is wearing a tight-fitting white tank top, stained with grease and dirt, and leaning against a red and white industrial pillar. The pose is dynamic—torso twisted, head tilted back, looking upwards and away from the camera. The lighting is crucial: employ dramatic, high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting, with a strong key light from the side that carves out the form of the body, highlights hyper-detailed muscle definition on the arms, and casts deep shadows. The visible skin on the face, neck, and arms must have a realistic oily sheen and be smudged with grease. The subject also wears grey mechanic's coveralls unfastened and tied around the waist, and worn, dirty work gloves. One hand rests on a car tire in the foreground. The color palette is muted, dominated by dark greens and greys, with the bright white of the tank top and the warm, golden light on the skin creating strong focal points. The final image should be sharp, high-resolution, and exude an aura of raw, masculine energy.

prompts.title: Race Day Stride
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the primary identity source. The generated runner must match the same person exactly, preserving precise facial structure, skull shape, jawline, cheekbones, eye shape, nose shape, lip shape, eyebrow thickness, hairline, hairstyle, skin tone, facial hair pattern, and overall anatomical proportions. Maintain true identity fidelity and likeness. Do not beautify, stylize, or alter facial features. Preserve natural asymmetry, skin texture, and facial geometry. The person must remain clearly recognizable.
Create a hyper-realistic sports photograph of the subject running at the front of a marathon or road race on a wide metropolitan city street. Portrait orientation, 4:5 aspect ratio, ultra-detailed 8K realism, professional athletic photography.
Subject — Pose and Motion (CRITICAL)

The subject is captured mid-stride in the airborne “flight phase” of running:
One leg driving forward naturally with proper anatomical running form
Opposite leg extended behind
Arms bent at approximately 90 degrees and positioned close to the torso
Hands relaxed in natural running form
Upright, balanced posture showing efficient athletic motion
Face perfectly sharp and clearly visible
Expression focused, determined, and forward-looking

Modern athletic performance red t-shirt (form-fitting, realistic fabric tension, compression folds)
Athletic running shorts with lightweight fabric and natural movement

Optional sports watch or fitness tracker

Wide metropolitan boulevard or city race route
Urban architecture such as modern or classical buildings on the sides

Spectators behind race barriers (naturally blurred)
Secondary runners behind the subject, progressively more blurred to create depth
Clean asphalt road surface with realistic texture

Bright natural daylight illumination
Soft directional sunlight from a natural angle (side or front-side)
Realistic shadows beneath the subject
Natural skin tones with accurate highlights and shadow transitions

Professional sports photography

85mm lens or similar telephoto compression

Subject in razor-sharp focus

High dynamic range
Realistic motion capture
Realism Requirements (CRITICAL)

Perfect facial identity match with reference image
Anatomically correct limbs, joints, and running form
No distorted hands, legs, or feet
No extra limbs or artifacts
No unnatural motion blur on face
No cartoon, stylized, or artificial appearance

prompts.title: Pull Day
prompts.prompt:
Using the uploaded reference image only for exact facial identity, create a high-quality, ultra-realistic fitness photograph set inside a modern commercial gym.

Face & Identity (STRICT — NON-NEGOTIABLE)

Preserve the exact facial identity from the reference image with absolute accuracy. Do not beautify, stylize, reinterpret, age, or alter the face in any way. Maintain identical bone structure, facial proportions, jawline, cheek shape, nose, lips, eyes, eyelids, hairline, and skin tone. Keep natural skin texture, visible pores, and subtle sweat. Facial expression must remain serious, focused, and intense.

Subject & Physical Appearance

The subject is a young athletic man with a lean, muscular, well-defined physique and low body fat. Clearly visible six-pack abs, defined pectorals, serratus anterior, and vascular arms. Biceps and triceps are fully engaged and under tension. Skin shows a realistic sweat sheen across the chest, shoulders, arms, and forehead, emphasizing physical exertion.

Hair natural styled with volume on top and slightly faded sides. Clean-shaven with a faint natural mustache shadow.

Attire

The subject is shirtless, wearing fitted black athletic track pants / sweatpants. No accessories or jewelry.

Action & Pose

The subject is performing a lat pulldown exercise. He is seated firmly on the machine with thighs secured under red padded supports.
His torso is slightly leaned backward (natural lat pulldown form) with the chest lifted and shoulders engaged, not fully upright.

Arms are fully extended overhead in the stretched phase of the repetition, gripping a wide angled metal lat pulldown bar with a wide overhand grip near the curved ends.

The head is naturally tilted slightly upward, neck aligned, and the subject is looking straight ahead into the mirror in front of him, maintaining focus and correct exercise posture. The pose feels realistic, controlled, and mid-rep rather than staged.

Equipment & Foreground

The lat pulldown machine includes red padded thigh supports tightly, visible just below the waist. In the immediate foreground, out-of-focus bright yellow metal bars partially frame the lower portion of the image, adding depth and a cinematic layered effect.

Camera Angle & Composition

The camera is positioned slightly front-left of the subject at chest height. The perspective subtly enhances upper-body depth, chest expansion, and arm extension without distortion. Vertical orientation, medium waist-up framing, emphasizing the upper body, arms, and lifted chest. Strong, dominant composition.

Lighting & Spotlight Effect

Strong overhead rectangular LED gym lights create a clear spotlight effect on the subject. Light falls from above and slightly forward, producing crisp highlights on the face, shoulders, chest, arms, and abs. Shadows are clean and controlled, enhancing muscle separation and realism. The subject is clearly illuminated while the background remains darker.

Color Tone & Grading

The image uses a cool-neutral cinematic gym color grade. Skin tones remain natural with subtle warm highlights. The environment leans toward cool greys and deep blacks, contrasted by bold yellow gym equipment. Moderate contrast, realistic saturation, no stylization.

Background & Environment

The setting is a busy commercial gym with black-and-yellow equipment. The background is intentionally blurred with a shallow depth of field, creating strong subject separation. Other gym-goers appear as soft silhouettes, including a person in a blue t-shirt to the left. Mirrors line the back wall, reflecting equipment and lights without drawing focus.

Mood & Style

The image conveys discipline, strength, focus, and hard work. An authentic gym training moment captured mid-effort.
Ultra-realistic photography, sharp focus on subject, natural proportions, realistic skin texture, cinematic depth, professional fitness photoshoot aesthetic.
